implemented: Versioned PG deployment publication with CAS, immutable history and exact old-request replay without reactivation.
Account lock serializes publication and OPEN prepare/submission, including the initially absent deployment row.
Typed immutable plan admission, optional signal receipt and permanent account-wide opportunity claim commit atomically; no order preparation or venue I/O.
Opportunity execution identity excludes instance, code version, generation and signal source; exact replay retains the original intent without refreshing permission.
OPEN prepare and submission verify current deployment, full frozen plan binding, database-clock lifetime and permanent opportunity receipt plus history.
Generic IntentStore cannot bypass permanent opportunity receipt checks for a new-schema plan.
Submission event records deployment and account-risk proofs within the existing order authorization transaction.
Stale new-entry denial is terminal for existing DataRuntime/Runner, while CLOSE and SUBMITTING/UNKNOWN recovery remain independent of entry generation.
Historical plan reader validates original scope, configuration, version, symbol, side, quantity and timestamps without requiring current ACTIVE mode or entry freshness.
Explicit STRATEGY_CAPITAL_ADAPTER_REQUIRED blocks new-schema use of the not-yet-migrated dynamic capital model.
Diagnostic retention tests protect both new permanent namespaces.
independent_review_fixes: Recheck new-plan entry lifetime at the database authorization point, even without an optional risk provider.
Reject a legacy deployment schema carrying a new-plan marker rather than silently skipping plan validation.
Enforce deterministic opportunity identity and permanent receipt at the generic Orders boundary, not only the high-level admission adapter.
Do not partially enable the legacy capital model by substituting only the leverage field.
Clarify that adapter failure rolls back admission; terminal handling of a second upstream signal belongs to the not-yet-connected worker.

qa.boundary: Dedicated disposable PostgreSQL/Redis instances; tests/v2_core/conftest.py rejects external TCP. Only fake exchange ports are used.

intermediate_runs.failure: New integration fixture called the keyword-only registry bind API positionally; corrected the fixture.
Five new fixture paths omitted required simulated exchange outcome evidence; one enabled capital without a matching sizing pool fraction. Existing production guards correctly rejected both.
Partial-fill fixture requested the full original close quantity; corrected to confirmed 0.005 exposure. No order safety check was loosened.

qa.scope: Affected core contracts and legacy-chain regression, not whole-repository or real exchange acceptance.

read_only_service_observation.scope: Service metadata only; previous pause/flatten acceptance is recorded separately.

remaining_before_activation: Complete shared old/new-plan capital and exposure adapters, including pending margin, stop risk and cost semantics.
Migrate protection, software exits, cash verification, settlement and analytics to explicit new-plan contracts without fabricating legacy strategy fields.
Retain versioned exit handlers for historical plans and isolate management scheduling from strategy/model waits.
Connect worker admission and persist terminal consumption for duplicate opportunities and expected denials; the adapter itself is not installed in a runtime worker.
Define causal TV/S3 opportunity identity upstream; identical supplied IDs deduplicate but unrelated source IDs do not self-normalize.
Define explicit migration for permanent namespaces before sandbox rebuild; current unknown-namespace rejection remains intact.
Complete new-plan lifecycle, venue-failure, load and recovery acceptance before any account execution is resumed.
profitability_claim: None. This work proves bounded execution contracts, not improved strategy returns.
